title: 按Win+L组合键会使得键盘管理器重新映射的按键和快捷键失效并使得键盘输入错乱

judgment.rationale: The issue already includes a ZIP and screenshot, and a comment says the failure occurs only when “lock computer” is disabled. The exact setting and remap are ambiguous, so ask only for those discriminators rather than another archive.
evidence: The report says pressing Win+L leads to Keyboard Manager remapped keys/shortcuts failing and keyboard input becoming disordered.
A comment says the issue happens only when the “lock computer” option is disabled.
The issue already has an attached ZIP and screenshot.
judgment.recommended_action: Clarify the exact option and mapping behind the “lock computer disabled” observation, then reproduce the Win+L transition.

fix_assessment.rationale: The existing evidence does not identify which setting is disabled or the affected remap; no code-level fix is supportable yet.

issue_context.summary: The reporter links Win+L to Keyboard Manager remaps becoming unavailable and keyboard input becoming disordered; the only comment narrows the behavior to a disabled “lock computer” condition.
known_information: The issue has one comment and labels Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Keyboard Manager.
A ZIP and screenshot are already attached.
The existing comment says the issue occurs only when “lock computer” is disabled.
inferences: The lock/unlock transition or a Windows policy/setting may be relevant, but the phrase “lock computer” is not specific enough to identify the state being toggled.
issue_context.analysis: Do not ask for another ZIP. A precise description of the disabled setting and the affected mapping would make the already-reported Win+L sequence testable and discriminate a lock-state interaction from a configuration issue.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and the single comment; confirmed that the archive and screenshot are already attached.
No linked code fix or related issue is identified.

information_gaps.information: The exact setting described as “lock computer” and the Keyboard Manager remap/shortcut that becomes disordered after Win+L.
information_gaps.why_needed: The comment gives a useful lock-state discriminator but does not identify which setting or mapping must be varied in a reproduction.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the exact setting name and where it is configured, the source-to-destination remap, and whether the failure occurs after pressing Win+L, locking/unlocking, or both.

actions.label: Clarify lock setting and affected remap

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and ZIP, and for noting that this occurs only when “lock computer” is disabled. To make that result reproducible, could you identify the exact setting name/location you mean by “lock computer” and the specific Keyboard Manager source-to-destination remap that fails? Please also clarify whether the failure starts immediately after pressing Win+L, after unlocking, or in both cases. No need to upload the same archive again.
